|game_text=May add Harc as a pilot. During battle, adds one destiny to total power. If opponent just deployed a Dark Jedi or Sith to a related site, may deploy a related location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 while at [[Bespin]]).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Overseer (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-110-Overseer-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Overseer (Virtual Block 6)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Overseer (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “May add Harc as a pilot. During battle, adds one destiny to total power. If a Dark Jedi or Sith was just deployed to a related site, may ▼ a related location. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 at Bespin).”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 51). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Overseer (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “If a Dark Jedi or Sith was just deployed” to “If opponent just deployed a Dark Jedi or Sith” and “(< 6 at Bespin)” to “(< 6 while at Bespin)” (the card list writes the ▼ icon out): “May add Harc as a pilot. During battle, adds one destiny to total power. If opponent just deployed a Dark Jedi or Sith to a related site, may deploy a related location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 6 while at Bespin).”.<ref name="cl-1261_106-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
